# Solutions

**[id 190]** John collects for 3 hours at 2 peaches/minute
- 3 hours = 180 minutes
- 180 × 2 = 360 peaches

**[id 191]** 10 ducks need 3.5 pounds per week per duck
- Weekly total: 10 × 3.5 = 35 pounds
- Daily: 35 ÷ 7 = 5 pounds

**[id 192]** Starts with 50 trees, gains 8 net per year (10 planted - 2 chopped)
- After 10 years: 50 + (8 × 10) = 130 trees
- 30% die: 130 × 0.70 = 91 trees

**[id 193]** Friday: 18 pink. Saturday: 1/3 of 18 = 6 become white. Sunday: add 18 pink
- Pink: 18 - 6 + 18 = 30
- White: 6
- Difference: 30 - 6 = 24

**[id 194]** 5 crayons at $2 each from $20
- Cost: 5 × $2 = $10
- Change: $20 - $10 = $10

**[id 195]** Pen costs as much as pencil ($1.20) + eraser ($0.30) = $1.50
- 8 pens: 8 × $1.50 = $12.00 or 1200 cents

**[id 196]** 40 restaurants get 2 pounds each from 200 pounds
- Used: 40 × 2 = 80 pounds
- Not used: 200 - 80 = 120 pounds

**[id 197]** Total 23786, minus 8417 men and 9092 women
- Children: 23786 - 8417 - 9092 = 6277

**[id 198]** Started with 20. Month 1: collected 60. Month 2: collected 40. Month 3: collected 200
- Total: 20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320 cards

**[id 199]** Mark edits 500 sentences each for two publishers
- Publisher A: 500 × 5¢ = 2500¢
- Publisher B: 500 × 10¢ = 5000¢
- Total: 7500 cents
